server.name: io.github.spendpreflight/spendpreflight
server.description: Preflight x402 payments. Base ERC-8004 agent #1151628; wallet binding verified Nov 3, 2026.
server.title: SpendPreflight

census.context: The ERC-8478 draft author’s October 28, 2026 Robinhood Chain census found 5 matching payment addresses among 5,575 agents returning x402 payment requirements (fewer than 0.1%), from 20,046 registered agents. Almost all mismatches came from one legitimate shared-treasury operator. This is a dated, single-chain observation, not an ecosystem-wide rate, ranking or evidence of fraud.

identity_binding.scope: Dated live observation, not continuous monitoring, reputation, delivery, safety or permission to pay.
identity_binding.statement: SpendPreflight's payout wallet (0xBf4164e07552e4c1b1B1597E72C7acAA3F0a1c58) is verifiably bound to its ERC-8004 identity on Base, agent #1151628. Registered November 2, 2026 Pacific (November 3 UTC); the live self-check returned verified-wallet on 2026-11-03T13:18:52.000Z at Base block 53461275.
